blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—Kieffer Alas’ confidence stood out in Ateneo’s 87-76 win over National University in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Philsports Arena on Saturday. Despite struggling early, Alas took the big shots down the stretch to help the Blue Eagles rally from 17 points down and beat the Bulldogs. The highly touted rookie knew he was cold from the field heading into the fourth quarter. But, as his dad and coach Louie Alas would say, when you have the clutch genes, you just have it. “Like what my dad-slash-coach […]...
